# The White Witch™

> Politics and social events, facts first. LibreSky is the Bluesky client. Emoji games, MAGIC, and RETRO for the C64, the Apple II, and the TI-99/4A. No paid posts.

## LibreSky

- [LibreSky](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/LibreSky/): Bluesky client. Edit, voice, video, and chat. The password stays with Bluesky.
- [LibreSky Corporate](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/corporate/): self-hosted, small enough for a Pi. Coming soon.
- [LibreSky source](https://github.com/TheWhiteWitchTM/LibreSky)
